conclusions.text: The 2022 DITTT BDADMIN-NC PROVINCES layer has exactly three valid nonempty official province multipolygons that map by name to all three issue subjects; its compatible redistribution license remains unverified because official license statements conflict.

The 2022 COMMUNES layer has 33 normalized names matching the legal New Caledonia commune names; law and 2025 census decree corroborate province membership labels and the Poya split but do not establish the dividing coordinates.

All three official source geometries closely match diagnostic MakeValid clones of the preserved invalid GeoReP originals, while differing materially from the pinned Natural Earth fallback. This supports a sourced correction proposal, but the exact licensed source release and fallback legal placement remain unresolved.

The exact Poya dividing line, inter-province/commune topology, offshore/islet completeness and appropriate final product scale are not certified. DITTT source terms also caution against assuming topological closure or systematic completeness.
